title: PM Roadmap
description: Business outcomes for one product. The unit is an outcome bound to a number, not a feature — which is why the lifecycle ends at 'measured' rather than 'shipped'.

product.description: Product slug this roadmap belongs to. One roadmap per product: outcomes are bound to that product's metrics and do not compare across products.

id.description: out-YYYYMMDD-slug. The date is the allocator, so two branches never mint the same id and no post-merge rename can break a dependency reference.

outcome.description: The business outcome in one sentence. Not a feature: 'first-month churn under 8%', not 'build onboarding emails'.

metric.description: The number that proves it. An outcome without one cannot reach 'measured'.

status.description: measured is terminal. shipped means the work left the building; measured means the number was checked afterwards.

visionOutcome.description: Which row of vision.md's 'What Must Become True' this serves.

documents.description: Vault-relative paths to the PRDs, specs, and analyses that serve this outcome.

harnessFeatures.description: blvck-harness feature IDs implementing it. The seam between the two plugins: they track different units and link rather than share a tracker.

dependencies.description: Other item ids that must land first.

measured.description: Required once status is 'measured'. Without it an item can be marked finished while the number it existed for is unknown.
